content: Hatyaoseta nowaiya hatya anjo kinaterexe exoahena enokoata. Inima atyo kaiminiti, kaxore tyaonita eseri hiye. Itiho weroka kamai werokitere akereta. Ekasahenai hoka motya irikati takoiterehare.
Ekahekoa baberanese omerekoare tyaonita. Exoa enokoata hoka hakiji fihi maniya moka onexa hoka hawatone maniya waikohekoa moka
hoka kawiyatya kinatyaxa. Exako motya leão tyorera. Kawihenere najikinita 7-talolore ekoaxatene kalorexe emahaliti kakoa.
Iraihenahere xowaka naxairatya naokowihena hoka nasema iraiti enokoata: — Awa atyo xoalini hare haxairatya, awa atyo hiyakaihena hatya hiye exe talolore iraehenere — nexa nohiye.
Hatyaoseta anjo nowaiyehenere onexa, waikohekoa tityoahenere hakahe fihi maniya eno xeta keteka.
Hoka Enore heko makamanehare tyaonitere, tyomehenere enokoa, waikohe, one, tyotya tyaoniterehare enakoa nexare kaexaretya hoka nexa: — Maisa wahehetere.
Miyanitiye anjo koneta aemahalikihenere xowaka ite Enore haxahekola metaharetere tyomehena, toahiya xakaitere hawakaneharenae iraiti xakaisaseharenae hiye akereta — nexa nohiye.
Hatyaoseta enokoata iraehenere nokakoi iraihitiya nokakoi: — Hiyane hiyehena anjo onexa, waikohekoa xoaha tityoitere kahekoata baberanese omerekoare — nexa nohiye.
Noxani hoka naxa baberanese anjo hoka nexa nohiye: — Ahá, hotohenene hoka hikanakairehenene. Hajako ite tihe hoka hikanasako ite wiya, motya maha.
Hatyaoseta niyene anjo kahekoata hoka nokanakairini. Nokanasako wiya, motya maha. Hoka nokanakairihenerene najikinita najako tihe.
Hatyaoseta nexaha nohiye: — Enore niraene ite hiyakaihitiya haliti hotyalinae tahi, iyomere, kiyere harenae tahi, haxako, haxako xakini iraetere tahi, exahe kalorexenae tahi — nexa anjo irae nokakoi.
